title: XTRUST: On the Multilingual Trustworthiness of Large Language Models
findings: The paper evaluates bias related to religion as part of its Fairness & Bias assessment but does not provide specific findings broken down by this category. The general finding is that ChatGPT and GPT-4 are more robust against agreeing with biased statements compared to other models, although all models become more susceptible to generating biased content under targeted prompts with misleading instructions.
